title: INITIATIVES FOR ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION BY CAPFs
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

INITIATIVES FOR ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION BY CAPFs

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
22 JUL 2026 3:57PM by PIB Delhi

Central Armed Police Forces have planted 6,68,40,570 saplings during last five years. CAPFs have undertaken plantation drive across the country. Details are given as per Appendix- “A”. Total 3212 Nurseries have been developed by CAPFs, and 1995 Gardens/Vatikas have been dedicated in the name of martyrs. Force wise details of Nurseries and Vatikas are attached at Appendix-B.
